The latest attack came barely a day after bandits killed Alhaji Nasiru Sani Kaura, an APC E-Registration Supervisor, and abducted several worshippers in a mosque during the early morning Subh prayer on Saturday.
An indigene of the town, Nababa Musa, told LEADERSHIP on Monday 16th November 2026 that the bandits, who rode on motorcycles, invaded the town in the early hours of Monday, firing gunshots to scare residents.
According to Musa, the bandits moved to the residence of one Alhaji Sama’ila at Sabuwar Kaura area, where they killed his watchman and abducted five members of his family.
“The bandits who were on motorcycles invaded our area in the middle of the night last Sunday carrying sophisticated weapons and started shooting sporadically to scare the residents and the security agents,” Musa said.
“They broke into the house of Alhaji Sama’ila after killing the security guard and abducted five members of his family.”
“They operated for several hours in the town without any challenge because neither the police nor the military came to the scene for rescue operation.”
Musa called on the state government and security agencies to come to their rescue, stressing that “the bandits have attacked the town three times in just three days.”
